title: Monthly campus emissions (v1)
description: One row per meter per billing month, ordered by meter id then month. Billing months are labelled by the month the billing period ends, with no pro-rating. Unknown extra fields are allowed.

emissions_unit.description: tCO2e: metric tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent.

scope.description: 1 for natural gas, 2 for purchased electricity (location-based).

period_end_month.description: YYYY-MM, the month the billing period ends.

quantity.description: Energy used in the billing month, in unit.

unit.description: kWh for electricity, therm for natural gas.

tco2e.description: Metric tonnes CO2e, rounded to six decimal places.

data_quality.description: Where the figure came from: bill, utility_export, chart_estimate or chart_measured. New values may be added.

estimated.description: True unless the figure is an exact bill or utility export figure.

uncertainty_pct.description: Stated uncertainty in percent, where one is given.

factor_id.description: The factor_id in factors.json used for this row.
